fusions.name: Thundering Pass
fusions.desc: Charges through, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). For 3 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Back-Kick
fusions.desc: A backward kick that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt for the Gate
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 8 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 30% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Heart
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%.
